positions.title: Software Engineer / Project Leader
positions.locationName: Brooklyn, New York, United States · Remote
positions.description:
- Led the **CambrianAI** project, prototyping a custom AI Browser using Puppeteer, the OpenAI API SDK for LLM integration, Whisper for voice integration, and ChromaDB as the vector store. Developed a custom AI agent framework, **Agentci** ([GitHub Repository](https://github.com/Odion100/agentci)), which leveraged AI agent function calling workflows and RAG to automate browser interactions based on natural language commands.
- Maintained and enhanced the legacy **Order Management / Shipping and Labeling** application—a robust MERN stack web application augmented with custom VBScript, MS Word label templates, and Excel VBA—that has supported operations for over 10 years.

positions.title: Software Engineer Project Lead
positions.description: Architected a real-time video composition and broadcasting pipeline using Mediasoup (SFU) and FFmpeg, enabling dynamic scene-based video rendering with support for overlays, such as scoreboards and embedded sponsorship graphics. Developed and deployed mobile applications, (React Native) and backend API using a custom framework: SystemLynx (ExpressJS and Socket.io). Authored detailed software specification documents for mobile interfaces, web APIs and broadcasting control systems. Managed the design and development of a promotional website.

positions.title: Software Engineer Project Lead
positions.description: Led the CambrianAI project, prototyping a custom AI Browser using Puppeteer, the OpenAI API SDK for LLM integration, Whisper for voice integration, and ChromaDB as the vector store. positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: At InRhythm, I’ve had the privilege to serve as a software engineer, contributing to one of the fastest growing, cutting edge modern product consultancy and digital innovation firms for a number of Fortune 50 enterprise clients. Its been a pleasure to provide my expertise and directly contribute to making a dent in the digital economy.
positions.insights: Skills: Vue.js · JavaScript · React.js · TypeScript · Node.js · React Native

positions.title: Senior Software Engineering Consultant
positions.description: Operated in pods embedded within client companies to deliver expert software engineering consulting services. Participated in internal training sessions and delivered live talks, including a slide presentation on SystemLynx, a framework I developed for building modular web APIs / RPC on top of ExpressJS and Socket.io.(SystemLynx GitHub)-as well as SystemView, a UI based unit testing platform for SystemLynx APIs. Collaborated with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless integration and high-quality software delivery across client projects.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Contributed to the **Mastercard Checkout Service (Click2Pay)**, a consumer-facing checkout utility integrating SDKs from major credit providers (Mastercard, Visa, Amex, Discover).
- Developed and extended **Spark**, an internal testing platform to isolate and debug third-party SDKs, enhancing system reliability.
- Built and maintained sandbox environments ("playgrounds") for comprehensive SDK testing.
- Implemented CI/CD pipeline integration using **Jenkins**, streamlining deployment and updates.
- Conducted troubleshooting calls with clients to resolve SDK integration issues.
- Spearheaded the **Maestro Card epic** by:
  - Planning and coordinating changes across multiple repositories within the Secure Remote Checkout (SRC) system.
  - Creating and presenting RFCs for stakeholder review.
  - Successfully adding Maestro Card as an option during checkout, broadening payment capabilities.
- Actively participated in feature planning, code review, and story pointing sessions.
- Trained and onboarded new engineers into **Team Krypton**, as well as maintained and updated onboarding documentation.

positions.title: Software Engineer / Consultant
positions.description:
- Developed and deployed mobile applications using React Native and backend API using SystemLynx (ExpressJS and Socket.io).
- Managed the design and development of a promotional website.
- Authored detailed software specification documents for mobile and web API development.
- Executed software project management tasks using Jira.
- Developed **simpleMongoQuery**, a Node.js package that simplifies constructing complex MongoDB queries using an intuitive string notation. ([GitHub Repository](https://github.com/Odion100/simpleMongoQuery))

positions.title: Software Engineer / Project Manager
positions.description:
- Developed custom **Order Management / Shipping and Labeling** application—a robust MERN stack web application augmented with custom VBScript, MS Word label templates, and Excel VBA.
- Automated repetitive tasks with solutions involving Excel VBA, NodeJS, and VBScript.
- Created an auto-updating product catalog and custom label-generating software integrated with MS Word for shipping processes.

positions.title: Software Developer / Database Administrator
positions.description:
- Grew leads 30% and total revenues 10%, by developing a custom Excel VBA Spreadsheet / SQL Server database to facilitate listings
tracking & management, and automatic ad publishing to multiple web sites.  
- Slashed response times by 50% developing database feature to send links of prospective apartments to clients in 1-click. 
- Developed User Forms in Excel VBA to collect and store client search criteria, and instantaneously match them with optimal listings.
- Saved thousands of man hours yearly by automating tedious data entry tasks.
